verdict.rationale: Adyen Agentic's Feed API documents batch uploads of up to 200 product items per request, and a single item can target multiple AI platforms in one request. This is a genuine first-party bulk capability, but it is limited to catalog syncing. missing for 10: bulk operations beyond product feed uploads (e.g., batch session, payment, or token management), detail on batch error handling or partial-failure semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
